svg.text: FRAME · view on the open back
R0 relief. Without it the fillet fouls
the PCB's sharp corner by ~0.33 and
proud of the PCB, so the seat is
ribbon relief 4 x 38 on the thick-
bezel edge, 17 from one end and 35
from the other, through the pocket
depth only. Sets the frame width - see
corner relief R1.4 at all four GLASS
pocket corners, and R0 at all four PCB
cavity corners. Both parts have sharp
STLs export flat-face-down and MIRRORED IN X (print_mirror = true)
